summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC., a Taiwan-based outsourced semiconductor assembly and test services provider dual-listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (8150) and Nasdaq (IMOS), furnished a routine Form 6-K announcing its participation in the UBS Taiwan Summit 2026 at the W Taipei Hotel on September 15-16, 2026. Senior Vice President of Strategy and Investor Relations Jesse Huang will present recent financial results, business trends and growth opportunities to institutional investors, with the accompanying investor presentation posted on the company's investor relations website. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; this is an ordinary investor-conference notice rather than a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
